A CENTURY OF EXCELLENCE

The iconic VISE-GRIP® received its first patent in 1924. Over the years the company changed ownership, helped America in WWII, and became the go-to tool for trade specialists in more than 120 countries worldwide.

WHY IRWIN®

IRWIN® is committed to builders and maintainers, to the ones who ensure everything works as it should; keeping the lights on; the water flowing; the indoor air just right, and so much more. Durable IRWIN® Tools are built to perform in the real world of tight spots and dimly lit uncomfortable environments. IRWIN® TRADE STRONG™ from start to finish since 1884.
